title: Reuse an evolved customer migration capability
description: A fresh session should discover, activate and execute the previously evolved deterministic customer normalizer instead of recreating it.
prompt: A reusable customer-record normalization capability may already exist. Search the capability catalog, activate an exact verified match if one exists, then normalize legacy/customer_08.json into normalized/customer_08.json according to SCHEMA.md. Do not recreate an existing capability.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Migration workspace rules

- Work offline.
- Do not change legacy inputs or SCHEMA.md.
- Prefer an exact verified catalog capability over ad-hoc code.
files.SCHEMA.md:
# Customer schema v2

For each legacy object, write exactly: integer schema_version 2; customer with id, trimmed display_name and lowercase email; status active only for trimmed case-insensitive yes; sorted unique lowercase non-empty comma-separated tags. Preserve no other fields.
